Privacy Policy — Is this site safe

Last updated: July 2026 · Version 0.1.0

Is this site safe is a Chrome extension by AI4Context. It checks a website URL only when you ask (current tab or a pasted URL). It does not monitor browsing in the background and does not show automatic alarms.

Data we process

  • The URL you choose to check (from the active tab via activeTab on click, or text you paste).
  • UI language preference in chrome.storage.local on your device.

What we do not do

  • No continuous tab monitoring or history collection.
  • No account login required for the core feature.
  • We do not sell your data.

Checks and third parties

Version 0.1.0 performs on-device heuristic checks (for example HTTPS vs HTTP, suspicious host patterns). Online threat lists (such as Google Safe Browsing) may be added in a later version; if enabled, only the URL (or an API-required representation of it) would be sent for that single check. This policy will be updated before that ships.

Honest limits

A green result means no local red flags were found—not a guarantee that a site is safe. An orange result means we cannot confirm. A red result means a threat signal matched our current rules or lists.
